recentItems.title: Frankie Freako | FULL MOVIE | Steven Kostanski | WTF Cult Comedy Horror Fantasy Adventure
recentItems.description:
FRANKIE FREAKO | Steven Kostanski | WTF, Cult, Comedy, Horror, Fantasy, Adventure https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBrrfZs-ew7M3edNTh8TO7vkh7gcAkuWB

Workaholic yuppie Conor is in an existential rut until one night he catches a bizarre ad for a party hotline hosted by a strange dancing goblin: Frankie Freako. Could this be just the recipe to spice up his boring life? Directed by Steven Kostanski, Frankie Freako stars Adam Brooks, Kristy Wordsworth, Conor Sweeney, Rob Schrab, Kate Freund, Elliott Kalan, Matthew Kennedy, and more.
